system.description: Action; forfeit Interact. Up to 2 different visible targets within 6 squares and within 2 squares of each other, separate Ranged rolls; each target once. Cannot use on consecutive turns. No lingering spheres or automatic splash. Button rolls one target; GM handles second target, phase costs and cooldown.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 12 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; forfeit Interact. Use normal Move to travel at least 2 squares straight toward one target and make one adjacent Melee attack. No extra movement or second attack. Cannot use while stinger is anchored or on consecutive turns. GM checks path and cooldown.

Action; one visible target within 5 squares. The tail must face the target; normal line of sight and cover apply. One energy shot, no automatic hit, poison or ongoing damage. Cannot use if the tail cannon is explicitly disabled.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 12 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; one adjacent target. No automatic grab or free second-claw attack. This melee fallback is homebrew.
Action; one adjacent target. No automatic knockback or extra hit for the second horn.

Action; forfeit Interact. Requires at least 2 squares of straight unobstructed movement toward the target during this turn, paid from the normal Move. One adjacent target, one attack roll. No free movement, pass-through attack, automatic push or extra collision damage. Cannot start the charge while already adjacent. On a miss, Dodge becomes 0 until the start of its next turn; then restore Dodge 1. GM checks path, phase cost and temporary Dodge.

Action; inspect a visible 3-square-long, 1-square-wide straight strip starting adjacent to the Flapper. Roll Intellect + Perceive against the ordinary detection difficulty or the target’s appropriate concealment result, as determined by the GM. The light illuminates this strip until the start of its next turn, but cannot see through solid cover or automatically defeat invisibility/concealment. GM handles light, perception roll and any hidden targets; no automated vision change.

After successfully detecting one creature with Searchlight, spend Interact to broadcast its position. One allied Egg Pawn within 6 squares receiving the signal gains +1 Advantage on its next attack against that creature before the start of the Search Flapper’s next turn. Normal line of sight and range still apply; it does not allow attacks through walls. One broadcast per round; multiple Search Flappers’ spotter bonuses do not stack. GM applies the bonus manually in the roll dialog.

Once per scene, spend an Action after detecting an enemy to alert up to 2 ordinary Egg Pawns designated as reserves before the encounter. They arrive at a GM-marked accessible entry point at the start of the Flapper’s next turn and use ordinary initiative, with no free immediate attack. Alarm can be prevented before arrival by disabling the Flapper or cutting its communication. No additional Pawns if none were allocated, no cloning existing combatants, no healing/resetting reserves, no endless spawning. GM places the preselected actors/tokens and tracks arrival; not automated.

Action; one adjacent target. One Melee attack roll for both blades. No automatic second hit, area damage or free retaliation. Used to resolve a close-range blade strike in tactical combat; the normal patrol behavior is hovering rather than active pursuit.

Action; one visible target within 5 squares. Consumes one bomb through normal ammunition tracking, even on a miss. Three bombs total; no free extra shots, automatic splash, lingering fire or ongoing Burning. The three-shot limit is a homebrew balance choice. Normal cover and defense apply.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 3 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; one adjacent target. Requires the intact balance ball. No free movement, second attack or automatic knockback. Unavailable after the ball is neutralized.
Action; one adjacent target while surfaced. No automatic armor bypass, grab, swallow or additional attack from body segments.

Action; requires already burrowed in suitable ground. Choose and visibly mark a 2x2-square emergence footprint within 3 squares of current position, connected through diggable terrain. At the start of the next turn, emerge and attack up to 2 different grounded creatures in or adjacent to that footprint, separate Melee rolls, each creature once. This relocation uses the next turn’s Move; no second Move that turn. Defenders may leave or prepare normally. No tracking, automatic hit or attack through an intact reinforced floor. Must remain surfaced until at least the start of the following turn. Defeat/disable cancels eruption. Button rolls at impact; GM handles markers, placement, delayed attacks and movement cost.

Action; forfeit Move. One visible target within 6 squares. Normal cover, range and defense. Cannot use on consecutive turns: mark the cannon cooling until the end of its next turn. No free second shot, automatic splash or homing around obstacles. GM tracks phase cost and cooldown; ordinary attack button rolls one target.

Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; one adjacent target. Can attack after normal flying movement. No free movement, return flight, automatic knockback or extra attack. This contact strike is a homebrew attack based on the supplied robot design.
Action; one visible target within 8 squares. Multiple leg emitters count as one attack roll, not a free attack per leg. Normal cover, line of sight and defense.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 12 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; forfeit Move and Interact. Up to 3 different visible targets within 8 squares, separate Ranged rolls; each target once. Cannot use on consecutive turns. No simultaneous Leg Laser or Stinger attack. GM handles targets, phase costs and cooldown; button rolls one target.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 12 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; one visible target within 3 squares of the token edge. Energy extends the stinger’s reach; no automatic armor bypass, poison, impalement or damage over time.

Action; forfeit Move and Interact. Descend to the arena surface and attack up to 3 different grounded opponents within 3 squares of token edge along an unobstructed common surface, separate Melee rolls, each once. Airborne targets are unaffected by the ground shockwave. Cannot use on consecutive turns. After resolving, movement is 0 and Dodge 1 until the start of the next turn; then restore movement 4 and Dodge 3. Does not auto-destroy platforms or launch characters. GM handles targets, surface checks, temporary stats and cooldown.
Action; one visible grounded target within 3 squares of token edge. Normal defense. No instant crush, automatic defeat or free scenery destruction.

Action; forfeit Move and Interact. Up to 3 different targets within 3 squares of token edge, separate Melee rolls; each target once. Cannot use on consecutive turns. No free follow-up Stomp or automatic knockback. GM handles targets, phase costs and cooldown.

Action; forfeit Interact. One visible target within 8 squares, normal cover and defense. Requires an accessible loose boulder or substantial rubble beside a leg; consumes that piece. No infinite conjured rocks, automatic splash or secondary collision damage. GM checks rubble availability.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 20 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; one adjacent target. Normal defense. No automatic reflected damage, free movement or collision chain. This fallback attack is homebrew.

Reduce HP damage from direct melee hits by 4, minimum 0, while the screens function. Ranged attacks and redirected Mine Tanks bypass this custom reduction. Does not prevent conditions, normal critical effects or Ring loss. Instead of damage, a melee attack scoring at least 2 successful hits may disable the screens until the start of Death Ball’s next turn. GM handles reduction and temporary disable. This softened tabletop protection is not the game’s complete physical-attack deflection.

Action; deploy one visible mine marker on a valid floor or ceiling square within 4 squares, normal line of sight. Three mines total per scene, maximum 3 active. A mine arms at the start of Death Ball’s next turn. At the start of each later Death Ball turn, it may roll 1 square along its existing unobstructed surface toward the nearest visible opponent, without crossing gaps or changing surfaces. On entering or being entered by an occupied square, roll Death Ball’s Intellect + Tech against that creature’s Dodge; a hit deals 6 base HP damage plus normal excess hits. The mine is consumed whether it hits or misses. One target and one attack per mine, no blast splash, no additional critical/Ring effects from this custom hazard. A successful damaging attack against a mine’s Dodge 1 destroys it safely. GM tracks markers, supply, timing and rolls; mines are hazards, not extra actor turns.

A character adjacent to an armed mine can spend an Action and pass Dexterity + Move or Power + Melee, Difficulty 2, to redirect it toward Death Ball. If the boss is within 4 squares along an unobstructed route, consume the mine and deal 8 HP damage to Death Ball, bypassing Bumper Screens with no extra critical. On failure, the character may retreat normally; no automatic blast is triggered just by failing this check. Must use a mine not already consumed or destroyed. GM handles route, roll and damage.

Action; one visible target within 3 squares. Fire attack; on at least 2 successful attack hits apply Burning under normal STTH rules. Normal defense and fire protection apply. No persistent terrain or automatic additional damage from remaining in the original line.

Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; forfeit Move and Interact. Up to 2 different visible targets along the same straight 3-square line starting adjacent to the robot, separate Ranged rolls; each target once. Burning on at least 2 hits against that target. Cannot use on consecutive turns. Does not also fire Flame Jet. Button rolls one target; GM handles second target, Burning, geometry, phase costs and cooldown.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 20 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; clear one adjacent 1-square section of ordinary exposed nonmagical ice or thaw a small frozen mechanism. Larger obstacles require GM-set time or checks. Does not automatically destroy reinforced structures, harm a creature or deal weapon damage as part of the same utility Action. No required infinite respawn is implemented.

Action; one visible target within 3 squares. Normal Ranged attack and defense. On at least 2 successful attack hits, may push the target 1 square directly away into a space its body can enter. Cannot push through solid barriers or occupied squares; no additional collision damage. Normal falling rules apply if pushed off a ledge. GM resolves forced movement.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 20 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; forfeit Move and Interact. Up to 2 different visible targets along one straight 3-square line starting adjacent to the robot, separate Ranged rolls; each target once. On at least 2 hits against a target, may push it 1 square directly away using Wind Blast restrictions. Cannot use on consecutive turns or also use Wind Blast that turn. Button rolls one target; GM resolves second target, geometry, pushes, phase costs and cooldown.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 20 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; clear one visible 1-square patch of ordinary loose smoke, dust or lightweight debris within 3 squares, provided there is somewhere for it to disperse. Does not remove magical effects, extinguish every fire, move heavy objects or automatically clear an entire battlefield. GM adjudicates obstruction and dispersal.

Action; one visible target within 3 squares. On at least 2 successful attack hits, apply Restrained until the start of Egg Blizzard’s next turn as a temporary ice binding, not a new Frozen condition. An affected target may spend an Action and pass Power + Melee or Dexterity + Move, Difficulty 2, to break free early; an adjacent ally may spend an Action to break the ice without damaging the captive. Normal defense applies. GM handles ice binding, escape and expiry; no automatic Stunned, unconsciousness or vulnerability.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 20 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; forfeit Move and Interact. Up to 2 different visible targets along one straight 3-square line starting adjacent to the robot, separate Ranged rolls; each target once. On at least 2 hits against a target, apply the same short ice binding as Freezing Jet. Cannot use on consecutive turns or also use Freezing Jet that turn. Button rolls one target; GM handles second target, binding, geometry, phase costs and cooldown.

system.description: Action; visibly coat one exposed ground square within 3 squares in ice until the start of its next turn. Treat it as difficult terrain while active; no automatic fall, damage or permanent immobilization. Only one active patch. Does not freeze creatures, deep water, machinery or whole structures automatically. GM marks and removes terrain.
Action; one adjacent target in front of the robot. Requires usable horn saw. No automatic armor bypass, multiple hits, ongoing bleed or extra attack for touching the target. Normal defense.

Optional Sonic Superstars-style loadout; disabled by default. GM may enable before the encounter. Action; one visible target within 4 squares. The same saw is unavailable for any other attack until the start of its next turn, when it returns. No second return-path hit or free extra attack. This option allows normal turning rather than the classic fixed-facing patrol. GM tracks shared saw state and selected version.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 20 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Action; one adjacent target. No poison, blood drain, automatic armor bypass or extra hit. Cannot use while the nose is embedded.

Action; forfeit Interact. Requires starting airborne at least 2 squares above a reachable ground target; use the normal Move to descend along a clear path and attack one adjacent creature. Must end at a valid ground square, not in solid terrain or an occupied square. Hit or miss, the nose embeds after the attack: movement 0 and Dodge 0 until freed. No free attack, extra damage from falling or automatic target restraint. GM verifies height/path and handles embedded state.
Action; one adjacent target. Short hops are part of ordinary movement and grant no free movement, flight, bonus damage or extra attack.
Action; one visible target within 5 squares. Normal defense and cover. Firing reveals its location and ends active camouflage until the start of its next turn. No free shot when becoming visible.
system.notes: Homebrew ammunition capacity: 12 attack uses. Each confirmed attack consumes one round, burst, salvo or charge, including a miss; not individual bullets or each projectile in a salvo. Recharge does not refill ammo. GM supplies ammunition or recharges energy stores, then edits Remaining ammo; no automatic refill.

system.description: Optional rocket-model attack, disabled by default for this green shooter. GM may enable before the encounter. Action; forfeit Interact and use normal Move to travel at least 2 squares straight toward one target, then make one adjacent attack. No automatic hit, extra attack or free movement. Ends camouflage. Requires open path; no turning within the charge and no sustained flight after it. GM checks path and selected model.

Action; while stationary against a suitable wall or matching surface, attempt normal Sneak against observers’ Perceive, with +1 Advantage to this concealment check. Success conceals its position until detected, moving or attacking. Not automatic invisibility, intangibility or immunity: known location, appropriate perception and ordinary area attacks still follow normal table rules. Attacking ends camouflage until at least the start of its next turn, and reactivating requires another Action. GM handles concealment and bonus; token invisibility is not applied automatically.

Action; forfeit Move. One visible target within 2 squares. Extend and retract the mace tail as one attack; no second return-path hit, extra attack, poison or automatic Stun. Requires functioning tail. After resolution, Rear Opening applies until the start of Skorp’s next turn. GM checks movement cost and position.
Action; one adjacent target. Homebrew fallback attack based on its claw design; no automatic armor bypass, grab or extra attack per claw.

Action; forfeit Move. One visible target within 3 squares, along a straight unobstructed path in front of Shellcracker. Uses Melee despite its extended reach. No automatic grab, armor bypass, second return-path hit or extra collision damage. Cannot use on consecutive turns while the claw resets. After resolving, Dodge becomes 0 until the start of its next turn, then returns to 1. GM handles facing, path, movement cost, cooldown and temporary Dodge.
Action; one adjacent target. Remains available while the large claw resets. No free follow-up, automatic grab or extra attack per pincer.
Action; one adjacent target. May follow ordinary hopping movement. No free attack per bounce, automatic knockback or damage added just for landing beside a target.

Action; one adjacent target. Requires extended spikes. One Melee roll, not an attack for every spike. No automatic poison, armor bypass, critical or free contact damage on the same hit. GM checks spike state.
Action; one adjacent target. Available with spikes retracted. No extra attack, forced movement or automatic Stun.
Gain 30 Rings. Stored until used. Consumes one item on use.

system.description: Additional gem for a compatible Gem Bracelet. When installed, grants one additional rank in an associated skill, following the bracelet's existing rules. Maximum five additional gems per bracelet, six bonus ranks total. Bracelet and installed gems occupy one slot together. Installation and skill allocation are GM-managed; this loose gem grants no passive bonus by itself.
system.source: Accessory entry based on the existing Gem Bracelet catalog rules, STTH 1.5.0 p.40.
system.notes: Track the bonus on the bracelet when installed; do not apply it twice from the loose gem.
